audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer describes the PRE-REWORK Aurelion Sol throughout. It names "Voice of Light" (which does not exist in his kit) in whys[5], spikes[1] and mid, and talks about "stars", "star coverage", "star-orbit poke" and "comet farm" in spikes[0], spikes[2], spikes[3], early, mid and wants[]. The packet flags it too: the page never names a single real ability.
audit.why: His actual kit is Cosmic Creator (P, Stardust stacks that permanently upgrade each ability), Breath of Light (Q, 750, a 3s channel), Astral Flight (W, 22/20.5/19/17.5/16, 1500, flies over terrain), Singularity (E, 12s, 90 mana, 750, percent-health with an execute at the centre) and Falling Star / The Skies Descend (R, 120/110/100, 1250, stun). None of the described mechanics are his.
audit.corrected: Every fabricated name and orbiting-star mechanic replaced with the real kit across whys[3..6], all four spikes, early, mid, late and four wants[] entries.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four decisive interactions were absent: Singularity's percent-health damage and centre execute, Breath of Light being an interruptible channel, Astral Flight flying over terrain to cut a retreat Karma has no dash to beat, and Stardust permanently upgrading each ability.
audit.why: Riot's text: Singularity's centre executes enemies below a percentage and the ability grants Stardust per second a champion is caught inside; Breath of Light is a channel and Astral Flight is flagged as one too, so Karma's W root and her Mantra CC cancel them; Astral Flight flies over terrain at 1500 range; Cosmic Creator says the stacks permanently improve each of his abilities.
audit.corrected: Execute and percent-health stated in dontsFull[2].d, spikes[2] and whys[6]; the channel cancel stated in spikes[0], mid and phases[2].why; the terrain retreat-cut in enemyWin and late; Stardust in dontsFull[0].d and breakdown.mid. Real cooldowns added to breakdown.cooldowns, which previously contained no digit.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer read Skill on the Levels 4-5 and Level 6 rows while the content layer and the packet levelChart both read Karma there.
audit.why: Falling Star is 120s at rank 1 and Stardust is barely banked at that point, so level 6 does not flip the lane; his first item is where Singularity becomes a zone Karma cannot cross. The 64% win rate over 25 games supports Karma holding the early rows.
audit.corrected: phases[3].side and phases[4].side moved to Karma with both whys rewritten. Rows 5 and 6 already read Aurelion Sol on both layers and stay there; their whys were still describing Karma's spike, so those were rewritten to match their own verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike ladder pinned the level-6 flip on a non-existent ability and never gave a cooldown anywhere.
audit.why: The real level-6 spike is a 120s Falling Star at 1250 range; the real first-item spike is Singularity's percent-health execute; the real late spike is Stardust having upgraded every ability and Falling Star becoming The Skies Descend.
audit.corrected: All four spikes rewritten onto the real kit with real numbers. Entry count unchanged at four.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string verbatim under "Q-poke the last-hits relentlessly"; dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string verbatim under "Trade at his range once items arrive"; dontsFull[1].d explained the W tether under a title about spending Mantra on waves.
audit.why: Each title asks a question the body did not answer.
audit.corrected: All three rewritten to answer their own titles, using the 950-vs-750 range gap, Singularity's percent-health execute, and Mantra's passive refund respectively.

notes:
WORST FABRICATION FOUND IN THIS SLICE. The entire content layer for karma vs aurelionsol describes the PRE-REWORK champion: "Voice of Light" appears three times and is not an ability he has, and "stars", "star coverage", "star-orbit poke" and "comet farm" describe an orbiting-stars mechanic the current kit does not contain. The packet flagged that no real ability was ever named. I replaced all of it with Cosmic Creator / Breath of Light / Astral Flight / Singularity / Falling Star / The Skies Descend. If any other lane's aurelionsol pages were generated from the same source text, they will carry the same fabrication.

CHART: full layer read Skill on rows 3 and 4 where content and the packet both read Karma; moved to Karma with both whys rewritten. Rows 5 and 6 already agreed on Aurelion Sol across layers, but their full-layer whys still described Karma's own spike, so I rewrote those two whys without touching the sides.

OPEN — NOT CHANGED: diff reads EVEN at 5.5/10 with Aurelion Sol carry threat 6/10, against a 64% Karma win rate over 25 games. That points to a Karma-favoured label, but I do not know which token the diff enum accepts for a favourable matchup (I have only observed EVEN and TRICKY in this champion's data), and 25 games is a thin sample. Left alone rather than guessed — see questionsForUser.

Unverified, so not asserted: the exact execute percentage on Singularity, how much Stardust The Skies Descend requires, and whether Karma's W root cancels Astral Flight mid-flight (the file flags it as a channel, but flight and channel cancellation are not obviously the same thing and I would not tell a player to bet a Flash on it).
